title: Traversable double-throat wormholes in a string cloud background
summary: This work constructs a new class of traversable wormhole solutions with a double-throat topology, modeled as a localized perturbation of the Ellis-Bronnikov metric in a string cloud background. Embedding diagrams and the analysis of curvature invariants, including the Kretschmann scalar and the Weyl invariant, illustrate the geometric transition from single to double-throat structures as a function of the perturbation amplitude.
